label: Stream Breakup
blurb: The way a video call or a live stream breaks up when data goes missing. Now and then a run of blocks is lost; the decoder patches the hole with the frame before and carries on adding the new changes on top, so that strip of the picture goes stale: people walk through it half there, old edges hang in the air and colours go wrong in square chunks. The damage heals in a sweep across the frame as fresh blocks arrive, and some blocks come through as flat green grey where there was nothing to patch with. Every break comes from real earlier frames, so it looks the same in playback and export.
